features.contract: Exact-build activation, required native entry/byte checks and process-local activation of the owned presentation addon. Unsupported builds fail closed.
Shared in-run XP receipt normalization, strongest racial/fortune contribution, native choices and deferred native award bookkeeping. Preserve caller classification and rounding.

One host-owned gold wallet; native actor balances/coinage/earned counters are projections. Use the strongest racial, current Gold fortune and total permanent armory-Gold contribution instead of summing equipment across participants.
Purchased caches debit once, share price/opened count and deliver a personal native item choice to every eligible participant. Deferred banks and repeated presentation must not create extra rewards.
Native guardian rewards; no supplemental item grant is installed for 0.130. Preserve each native skill/item reward once.

Complete group pause while any relevant spell/item/cache choice or manual pause remains open. Host simulation and guest prediction stop; movement is blocked after the local player has chosen too. Picking remains possible; one `picked` event cannot resume everyone. Pause entry also sends native visual stop updates for remote participants, without changing authoritative actor coordinates or stopping network processing.

Allied direct heals, periodic heals and shields use player eligibility, range, missing-health/pressure rules and original-caster native coefficients/counters. Foreign periodic effects retain their producer and aura lifetime.

Foreign Thorns/Lightning Shield retaliation, Holy Nova/Holy Shock allied heals and shield/healing talent interactions preserve caster attribution, native proc cooldowns and current modifiers. Ice Barrier remains caster-only.
Hunter's Mark shares the strongest valid vulnerability and maintains native mark visuals without duplicate damage application. Owner death/leave and replacement must reconcile.

Eligible Shield Slam, Hammer of Justice and Shred hits establish persistent pursuit/basic-melee ownership. Required talents, hit success, enemy life and player GUID are checked. Special abilities retain native targeting policy.

Entering temporary immunity discards old taunts and ordinary aggro. Immune actors leave the ordinary NPC candidate pool; a fresh taunt remains possible during immunity. Candidate flags are restored after the native pass.

Resurrection Sickness: +1 stack on resurrection, -5% outgoing damage/healing per stack, cap 3; one stack recovers per 60 alive simulation seconds. Native harmful-aura name/icon, stacks and remaining time; pauses/death suspend recovery.

Sayge's Dark Fortunes: one persistent replacement buff per player, Sayge-trial replacement when ASX-28 is enabled, otherwise one roll per completed native boss encounter (not per entity), fixed category/rarity weights, bonuses rounded to whole percentage points before application and display, five-encounter scaling cap and continued endless replacements. XP/Gold use the strongest current fortune per category in coop; Luck remains personal. Native buff tooltip and reward notification. Active rewards are Luck, Experience and Gold only; movement speed and pickup radius are no longer rolled. Classic-style tooltip uses a white heading and green effect, with separate own/effective party values when a stronger shared fortune applies. ASXUI moves the native Fortune button to the first visual buff slot without changing buff indices or click handlers.

Exclude the three native economy trinkets (`insignia`, `eldre_thalas`, `chosen`) from ASX reward candidates. Gnomish Universal Remote (`remote`, pickup range) is available again. Do not delete inventory or broadly filter other equipment.
Glyph gameplay intentionally disabled. Retain all nine class catalogs and shared bonus/card representations without installing glyph choices or spell mutations.

Ring enchantment kind locks on the first accepted upgrade. Five total-value tiers at native ring ranks **2/4/7/10/14**, with Minor/Lesser/unprefixed/Greater/Superior names and the five native icons. Per-ring progression, additive stats, preview/apply/improve status and no rebuild accumulation. Capped native rings may remain unenchantable or low-tier (accepted V1 limitation). Declined enchantment previews retire at the validated native reward-choice boundary, before reentrant creation of the next reward; accepted enchantment kinds remain locked. Independent random draws may legitimately repeat.

Enrich existing native party frames with missing positive buffs, compact remote spell/item builds and owner-correct tooltips through private AZS_RUN.asx, without retransmitting the recipient build. A versioned native-style ASX addon contract exposes detached local feature values separately from ASX-authored text. Keep native health/name/death/resurrection widgets; preserve native five-player capacity. Glyph/fortune/fatigue presentation must keep source identities and expire stale cosmetic data.

Native party and reward presentation. Lobby class-icon decoration, atlas capture and roster cache invalidation are retired; native lobby rendering stays untouched. Group waiting presentation names the relevant characters and separates local choice/menu from remote waiting. Shared enchantment/gem card blocks keep native gains, one native separator, a centered two-column header (32px icon beside stacked title/status), values below and compact retained-bonus hover. Glyph gameplay remains disabled.

ASX run-state isolation: reset on native run/session/clock rollback, rebind slot plus GUID, preserve authoritative native context swaps and owned pending deliveries. Solo extensions use solo identity without reading inactive coop contexts.

Native-folder installer/launcher, exact supported-client registry, normal-DLL checks, owned addon deployment, shared native-save preservation/backups, signed update/rollback, report export and uninstall/restore. No game assets or legacy custom launcher are shipped as ASX gameplay dependencies.
Upstream-native personal marks. ASX duplicate-loot gold compensation is disabled; preserve native collection and reward ownership.

Crystal Resonance replaces amulet gems: independent map-wide UnGoro crystals, free equal color draws, individual once-only claims, one shared 60-second simulation deadline after the first claim, common removal after all eligible players collect or timeout, personal additive run-local bonuses and one native permanent buff with cumulative tooltip. No minimap pins. Prototype Red +10% damage, Blue +5% cooldown recovery, Green +15% maximum health, Yellow +10% area of effect; 4–6 random opportunities in the normal-run window and continued endless generation.

Independent ASXUI addon styles native enemy nameplate widgets at 70% scale by default; friendly plates, native health updates and visibility controls remain native. Levels/skulls are hidden; enemy names are hidden unless a unique highlighted native target is positively identified as elite/guardian/boss/final. Missing, ambiguous and untargeted identities remain hidden. No ASX DLL plate hooks are installed.

Independent ASXUI preserves the native world-number font by default and optionally selects an OFL font with one-third glyph size for the native world-number renderer at client startup; this shared face also affects native world-healing text. Native ASX direct/periodic healing amounts remain attached above allies through the existing world-text queue, with identity-bound fractional accumulation and native critical animation. No native damage-size interception remains.

One-time host initialization of distinct random native participant markers from all eight icons. Every existing mark stays reserved, already marked players are skipped, and live rechecks preserve manual changes; late joins initialize once and new runs reset observation; no solo assignment. Automatic participant assignment excludes skull, reserved for Treasure Goblins; existing manual assignments are preserved.

Optional host-owned Treasure Goblins in solo/coop: native creature creation and object transport, fleeing movement, 25 simulation-second expiry, no attacks/ordinary loot, taunt immunity, rare encounter-based appearances and personal native amulet/mark rewards. A separate launcher setting and optional contact checks preserve core ASX when disabled/unavailable. First-opportunity bad-luck protection uses increasing pre-final encounter odds (25%, 1/3, 50%, 100% on five-boss maps), never before the first boss; selected opportunities use a 20-40 second placement delay. Later appearances remain rare. Goblins receive the native skull marker when free, without displacing manual marks.

Optional Lost Supplies: cooperative aura projection activates independently of Fortune/fatigue and retires expired slots; native cargo pile, map-wide placement/ASXUI-owned native-masked circular minimap icons and native-cache pins read from AZS_CHESTS, ASXUI discovery notifications with configurable position, scale, opacity and visibility (opaque by default), with instant removal, multiple 90-second reserves, 60-second buffs across seven simultaneous consumable families with three encounter-based tiers, same-family renewal without stacking, twelve material variants and normalized whole-gold sales. Native temporary buff slots and stat-input restoration; host-owned cooperative scenes, identity-bound personal rolls/claims, individual hiding and shared material sales. Swiftness Potion grants 10/15/20% movement speed by tier. Name color uses Classic reference item quality independently of gameplay tier, sale power and drop weights. Event notifications use Classic tooltip/quickslot assets and Friz Quadrata text with existing configurable anchors and lifetimes.

Optional Sayge’s Trial: native encounter trigger only between bosses, native ground rune, decorative Classic Sayge and candles, map-wide placement with flatness preference and walkable fallback/ASXUI minimap pin, persistent unfinished scene with stable identity and encounter-upgraded reward, cumulative presence that suspends until every active participant returns, explicit collective-wait presentation, bounded randomized power, automatic Fortune replacement and ASXUI progress UI with configurable position, scale, opacity and visibility, shown only during native circle presence. Host-owned cooperative scene and shared progress require every active participant inside; personal Fortunes replace cooperative boss grants, with strongest XP/gold contributions preserved.
